name: Career Essentials in Generative AI by Microsoft and LinkedIn
description: Five-course professional certificate from Microsoft and LinkedIn Learning covering generative AI fundamentals, AI concepts, AI literacy, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and ethical considerations of deploying generative AI. Completed all 5 courses (4 hours) and passed the final assessment.

criteria.narrative: Completed all five courses in the Career Essentials in Generative AI by Microsoft and LinkedIn learning path on LinkedIn Learning: Generative AI: From Prompts to Partnership, Everyday AI Concepts, Your Top AI Questions Answered: AI Literacy for Everyone, Learning Microsoft 365 Copilot for Work, and Ethics in the Age of Generative AI. Passed the final summative assessment to earn the certificate.
